title: Three pixels into two — partial footprints
why: The case a box filter at integer ratios never reaches, and the reason the kernel is defined as an **area average over exact source footprints**: destination 0 covers `[0, 1.5)`, so pixel 1 contributes half its area — `(0 × 1 + 90 × 0.5) / 1.5 = 30` — and destination 1 covers `[1.5, 3)` for `(90 × 0.5 + 240 × 1) / 1.5 = 190`. No kernel radius, no edge-extension rule: a footprint is clipped to the source rectangle and never samples outside it.
